title: Mechanisms Producing Equatorial Superrotation
exact_target: Identify which large-scale heating and smaller-scale momentum transfers produce eastward equatorial winds.

status_qualification: The report gives a mechanism and sufficient conditions in a canonical balanced model. It does not provide universal necessary-and-sufficient conditions for all planets or all atmospheric regimes, and that broader claim is not substituted for the stated request.
